description: Source file for Dynamo's function-related variable tracking classes in PyTorch, handling user-defined functions, built-in methods, wrapped functions, and function special types for symbolic execution.

classes.name: FunctionSpec
classes.description: Represents a parsed function's signature including argument counts, names, defaults, and related metadata.

classes.name: BaseUserFunctionVariable
classes.description: Base class for variable tracking of user-defined functions.

classes.name: UserFunctionVariable
classes.description: Tracks a standard Python user-defined function and handles calls, attribute access, closure variables, and special methods.

classes.name: TreeMapOnlyFunctionVariable
classes.description: Special variable for functions that act as strict tree map functions with type restrictions.

classes.name: BuiltinMethodVariable
classes.description: Tracks external built-in methods for variable call tracking.

classes.name: LocalGeneratorObjectVariable
classes.description: Represents generator objects created by functions.

classes.name: ContextlibContextManagerLocalGeneratorObjectVariable
classes.description: Special generator object type for functions decorated with @contextlib.contextmanager.

classes.name: LocalGeneratorFunctionVariable
classes.description: Wrapper around generator functions providing iteration and argument binding.

classes.name: UserMethodVariable
classes.description: Tracks user-defined method functions, including support for bound methods.

classes.name: WrappedUserMethodVariable
classes.description: Wraps a UserMethodVariable with execution context support.

classes.name: WrappedUserFunctionVariable
classes.description: Wraps a UserFunctionVariable with execution context support.

classes.name: ClosureConversionError
classes.description: Exception raised when closure conversion fails due to unsupported or recursive closure structures.

classes.name: TritonKernelVariable
classes.description: Represents a Triton kernel, managing call and method dispatch, specialization, and source info.

classes.name: TMADescriptorExperimentalVariable
classes.description: Metadata description for experimental TMA descriptors, including reconstruction and tensor extraction.

classes.name: TMADescriptorStableVariable
classes.description: Metadata description for stable TMA descriptors with tensor and block shape info.

classes.name: CreateTMADescriptorExperimentalVariable
classes.description: Factory for creating experimental TMA descriptors with validation and argument parsing.

classes.name: CreateTMADescriptorStableVariable
classes.description: Factory for creating stable TMA descriptors from tensor and shape inputs.

classes.name: PyTreeGetNodeTypeFunctionVariable
classes.description: Optimized specialized function for determining a node's type in torch.utils._pytree, with shortcut for namedtuple cases.

classes.name: PyTreeTreeIsLeafFunctionVariable
classes.description: Specialized function for determining if a PyTree node is a leaf, optimizing the common case where `is_leaf` is None.

classes.name: SparseTensorCreationSkipVariable
classes.description: Skip variable that emits a message specific to unsupported sparse tensor creation functions, with reasoning.

methods.description: Returns the source for supported nodes in pytree, cached for efficiency.
